reviews.title: Too many bugs in app
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to buy 3 kegs using the World Cup offer and it won’t let me add anything to my basket. The same thing happens when I try to buy in store.

reviews.title: Widget doesn’t work if set to clear icons
reviews.text: Good app, but the widget which I was hoping to use just shows as a white box when icons on ios26 are set to clear.

reviews.title: App useless
reviews.text: My wife bought the perfect draft for Father’s Day and the first keg in worked perfectly with the app and I could turbo cool the keg. When finished I put a new keg in and the app still has the info from the last keg. Can’t rapid cool the new keg as the useless app still thinks the old keg is in the machine. If you Gona make a useful app try testing the thing before going to market or at the very least have a refresh button so the app can recognise a new keg. Now got to wait hours and hours for the new keg to be ready. Might as well go to supermarket and get some beers that will be cheaper and quicker to chill!!

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: Love the perfect draft machine and leg selection. Bit the app is awful. Constantly freezes when going between the menus

reviews.title: ImPerfect Draft!
reviews.text: DO NOT DOWNLOAD! App never works now, despite trying all the suggestions. No support from ‘app support’ Very poor service.

reviews.title: Never works
reviews.text: App literally never works. Either can’t log in. Can’t recognise my machine. Just consistent loading pages that never load. Truly the worst app I’ve ever used. I never write reviews but this is so frustrating to use I can never actually order anything making everything redundant.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: While the machine is great, the app leaves a lot to be desired. Continually there are issue with it where it’s down, so you can’t buy beer kegs!!
